name: tiemvio-pos-template
description: Tiemvio POS — mẫu ứng dụng bán hàng sạch cho từng cửa hàng

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-legal.mjs && node scripts/generate-ios.cjs && vite build web
scripts.test: node --test tests/push-worker.test.mjs tests/restructure.test.mjs tests/date-picker.test.mjs tests/update-policy.test.mjs tests/release-feed.test.cjs tests/ios-profile.test.cjs tests/download-routing.test.mjs tests/app-display.test.cjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-configured.cjs && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.release:prepare: node scripts/prepare-release.cjs && node scripts/generate-legal.mjs && node scripts/generate-ios.cjs

author: Nguyễn Giang Bảo
